events.did: told Eli that an EO killed his family and nearly killed him
events.quote_anchor: “Almost three years ago, an EO killed my family,” he said. “And nearly killed me.”

events.did: said EOs are a puzzle he is determined to solve, and that he needs as many pieces as possible
events.quote_anchor: “EOs are a puzzle,” he said, “One I’m determined to solve. To do that, I need as many pieces as possible.

events.did: led Eli through a sealed door into a cavernous space holding a cell
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel led him through a sealed door, and into a cavernous space.

events.did: paced frantically in the cell, clawing at his hair and muttering that he cannot remember
events.quote_anchor: A teenage boy paced frantically, hands clawing at hair. He muttered to himself, the words amplified by the speakers outside the cell.

events.did: said she moved the boy to the holding cell when he started breaking things
events.quote_anchor: “I moved him to the holding cell when he started breaking things.”

events.did: put his palm on Xavi’s head and made him crumble to ash
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel’s hand dropped through Xavi’s head as it collapsed.

events.did: laid a hand on Eli’s shoulder and told him that EOs who have served their purpose no longer belong
events.quote_anchor: “But once I’ve learned everything I can, once they’ve served their purpose, well … we both know where EOs belong.”

events.did: resolved to put Gabriel in the ground after watching Xavi destroyed
events.quote_anchor: And Eli would put him in the ground.

relations.did: is bound to Gabriel by an invisible cord and fights to push him back
relations.quote_anchor: The cord drew taut as he fought to push Gabriel back. A waste of energy. For both of them.

relations.did: is Gabriel’s opposite in method — Eli kills EOs while Gabriel brings them back
relations.quote_anchor: “I doubt it,” muttered Eli, “seeing as I kill EOs. And you bring them back.”

relations.did: destroyed his patient Xavi with his touch, turning him back to ash
relations.quote_anchor: Eli watched, in fascination and in horror, as the one EO, flesh and blood moments before, crumbled to ash beneath the other’s touch.

relations.did: is the one who took over from Helena in the cell
relations.quote_anchor: “Thank you, Helena,” he said, pushing down his sleeves, only to roll them up again, as if readying himself. “I’ll take it from here.”

numbers.who: the EO who killed Gabriel’s family
numbers.did: did it Almost three years ago
numbers.quote_anchor: “Almost three years ago, an EO killed my family,” he said.

numbers.who: the guards posted in the large dark space
numbers.quote_anchor: It was a cube of plexiglass and steel sitting in the center of a large, dark space, four guards up against the walls.

numbers.who: the guards who flanked Gabriel when he entered the cell
numbers.quote_anchor: Eli watched as Gabriel entered, flanked by a pair of guards.

numbers.did: moved through EON unguarded and alone for the first time
numbers.quote_anchor: For the first time, he moved through EON unguarded. Alone. But he didn’t try to run.
